answers.10: Ohm's law states that voltage equals current times resistance (V = I x R).
answers.11: Newton's second law states that force equals mass times acceleration (F = m x a).
answers.12: Kinetic energy is proportional to mass and to the square of velocity (KE = 1/2 m v^2).
answers.13: Power measures the rate at which energy is transferred or work is done, in watts (joules per second).
answers.14: Density is defined as mass per unit volume.
answers.15: Hooke's law relates the force exerted by a spring to its displacement from equilibrium (F = -k x).
answers.16: Electrical power equals voltage times current (P = V x I).
answers.18: Momentum equals mass times velocity (p = m x v).
answers.19: Revenue equals price times quantity sold (R = P x Q).
